name: Crossgates Commons Plaza
summary: Crossgates Commons Plaza is a well-established community shopping center on Washington Avenue Extension in Albany, offering convenient access to national retailers and everyday services. With a 4.3-star rating from over 2,400 reviews, this open-air plaza serves as a popular shopping destination for Capital Region residents seeking a diverse mix of stores in an accessible location.
demographics: Crossgates Commons Plaza attracts a diverse middle to upper-middle class demographic from the Albany metropolitan area, with a strong representation of families and working professionals aged 25-54. The trade area serves the Capital Region's suburban communities, drawing shoppers with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $100,000+ who value convenience and variety. Primary visitors include busy families seeking one-stop shopping for groceries, home goods, and everyday essentials, as well as young professionals looking for quick dining and retail options. The center benefits from its proximity to Crossgates Mall and major highways, capturing both destination shoppers and convenience-oriented local residents.
description: Crossgates Commons Plaza is a prominent community shopping center located at 161 Washington Avenue Extension in Albany, New York, serving as a vital retail hub for the Capital Region. This open-air shopping destination offers a convenient and accessible shopping experience with ample parking and a diverse mix of national retailers and service providers. The center has established itself as a go-to location for everyday shopping needs, featuring a strong anchor tenant presence and complementary specialty stores that cater to the daily needs of Albany-area residents. With operating hours from 10:00 AM to 9:30 PM, Crossgates Commons Plaza provides flexibility for shoppers throughout the day, whether they're running quick errands or enjoying a leisurely shopping trip. The center's strategic location along Washington Avenue Extension, combined with its well-maintained facilities and tenant mix, has earned it a solid 4.3-star rating from over 2,400 reviews, reflecting its popularity and reliability among local shoppers. As part of the greater Crossgates shopping district, the plaza benefits from significant foot traffic and serves as an essential retail destination for families, professionals, and students throughout the Albany metropolitan area.
